title: Define REDDHI once with one consistent foundational core
requirements:
- Give a concise definition stating that REDDHI names a state of maturity, not a set of components
- Use one authoritative foundational-core list in the 2.2.1 narrative and Table 2.2
- Present full-STAC as the technical and content foundation within broader enabling conditions (governance, financing, workforce, community)
- Explain its relationship to DPI, DPI-F and DPI-H, or reduce the number of overlapping terms
- Clarify that Table 2.2 covers technical capability, with a pointer to non-technical foundations
- Consider configurable content and implementation community as dimensions
- Explain how the words in the expansion relate to each other
- Tie the 'minimum viable foundation' to selected national priorities rather than a universal package
